intro: Katowice rewards visitors with striking post-industrial architecture, top museums and a lively music scene. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Trams and buses run by ZTM Metropolia cover the whole metro area with one ticket system.
A 20-min ticket is 4.60 zł, 90-min or full-route 6.60 zł, and a day pass 12 zł.
Validate your ticket on boarding; inspectors fine unvalidated tickets.
Buy tickets at kiosks, machines or POP points; drivers sell only the 90-min ticket, cash only.
Uber and Bolt work well; agree taxi prices beforehand or use an app.
The centre is walkable; Metrorower yellow bikes rent via app across the region.

spodek.name: Spodek
spodek.price_text: Free to view outside · event tickets vary
spodek.hours: Exterior always visible · interior only during events
spodek.tip: The flying-saucer hall is best seen from the wide plaza by the Rawa river. Check the event calendar before you go.

silesian-museum.name: Silesian Museum
silesian-museum.price_text: ≈ PLN 20–35 for permanent exhibition · check on the day
silesian-museum.hours: Usually Tue–Sun, closed Monday · check on the day
silesian-museum.tip: Most of the museum sits underground in a former coal mine. Go up the mine tower for a city view.

auschwitz.name: Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum
auschwitz.price_text: Entry free · guided tours charged, book ahead
auschwitz.hours: Open daily, hours vary by season · check on the day
auschwitz.tip: It is about 30 km from Katowice. Book a timed entry or tour online well ahead and allow most of a day.

legendia.name: Legendia (Silesian Amusement Park)
legendia.price_text: ≈ PLN 70–110 day ticket · check on the day
legendia.hours: Seasonal, mostly spring–autumn · check on the day
legendia.tip: It is in Chorzów, a short tram ride from the centre. Go on a weekday in summer to avoid queues.

rynek.name: Rynek (Market Square)
rynek.tip: Start here for orientation. Cafes and bars line the square, and it is lively in the evening.

mariacka.name: Mariacka Street
mariacka.hours: Always open · bars busiest at night
mariacka.tip: A short pedestrian street of bars and small shops. Good for an evening drink.

nikiszowiec.name: Nikiszowiec
nikiszowiec.tip: A red-brick miners' estate with a strong local feel. Walk the streets and stop for coffee.

food-market.name: Katowice food market (hala targowa area)
food-market.hours: Mornings, mostly weekdays · check on the day
food-market.tip: Go in the morning for fresh produce and local cheese. Bring cash for small stalls.

viewpoint.name: Mine tower viewpoint at the Silesian Museum
viewpoint.hours: Museum hours · check on the day
viewpoint.tip: Climb the old mine shaft tower for a wide view over the city. Clear days are best.

walking-tour.name: Central Katowice walking tour
walking-tour.hours: Usually daily, book ahead · check on the day
walking-tour.tip: A guided walk covers the Rynek, modernist buildings and local history. Book a day ahead.

koszutka-walk.name: Koszutka modernist district walk
koszutka-walk.tip: Walk the wide avenues and socialist-era blocks north of the centre. Quiet and photogenic.

park-slaski.name: Silesian Park (Park Śląski)
park-slaski.tip: A large green park with paths and a planetarium nearby. Good for a relaxed half day.

pierogi.name: Pierogi lunch in the centre
pierogi.hours: Lunch and dinner · check on the day
pierogi.tip: Try pierogi and a bowl of żurek. Look for a busy milk-bar style place for value.

nightlife.name: Evening bars around the Rynek
nightlife.tip: Bars fill up late. Keep an eye on your belongings in busy spots.

tram-ride.name: Tram ride across the city
tram-ride.tip: Buy and validate a ticket before boarding. Trams are an easy way to reach Chorzów and Nikiszowiec.

stays.why: Right on the main square. Walk to most sights, bars and restaurants; best for a short first visit.
The wider centre around the Rynek and station. Good transport links and a wide choice of hotels.
Quiet, green and residential, a short tram ride from the centre. Good value for longer stays.
Calm western district near parks and the Silesian Park side. Cheaper rooms; rely on trams to the centre.

food: Try Silesian classics: rolada (beef roll) with kluski dumplings and modra kapusta (red cabbage).
Order a bowl of żurek (sour rye soup) or a hearty kotlet schabowy at a milk bar (bar mleczny) for a cheap lunch.
Look for Silesian sausage and krupniok (blood sausage) at markets and casual grills.
Katowice has a strong café and craft-beer scene around the Rynek and Mariacka street; prices are lower than in Kraków.
Vegetarian and vegan spots are easy to find in the centre; check menus on the day, hours vary.
more_time: Swap a day for Nikiszowiec: a historic miners' estate with red-brick houses and a small museum, reachable by bus or tram.
Add a trip to the Silesian Park (Park Śląski) with its zoo and planetarium, a short ride west of the centre.
History fans can spend a half-day at the Auschwitz-Birkenau memorial, about 1.5 hours away by road; book a tour or check transport on the day.
